name: Bromisoval
summary: Bromisoval (INN), commonly known as bromovalerylurea, is a hypnotic and sedative of the bromoureide group discovered by Knoll in 1907 and patented in 1909. It is marketed over the counter in Asia under various trade names (such as Brovarin), usually in combination with nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

uses.text: It is marketed over the counter in Asia under various trade names (such as Brovarin), usually in combination with nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

pharmacology.en: It is a simple acylurea sedative, thought to damp brain activity in the manner of related compounds. Part of its effect comes from the bromide it releases, which substitutes for chloride in nerve cells and makes them harder to fire.
pharmacology.zh: 它是結構簡單的醯基尿素鎮靜劑，一般認為其抑制腦部活動的方式與相關化合物類似。它的部分作用來自釋出的溴離子，這些離子會取代神經細胞中的氯離子，使細胞較難放電。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是结构简单的酰基尿素镇静剂，一般认为其抑制脑部活动的方式与相关化合物类似。它的部分作用来自发布的溴离子，这些离子会取代神经细胞中的氯离子，使细胞较难放电。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness and poor coordination. Because it releases bromide, which leaves the body very slowly, long use can cause bromism: confusion, slurred speech, memory problems, an acne-like rash and in severe cases delirium.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡與協調變差。由於它釋出的溴離子排出極慢，長期使用可能造成溴中毒：混亂、口齒不清、記憶問題、類似痤瘡的皮疹，嚴重時出現譫妄。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡与协调制差。由于它发布的溴离子排出极慢，长期使用可能造成溴中毒：混乱、口齿不清、记忆问题、类似痤疮的皮疹，严重时出现谵妄。

fact.en: It was discovered by Knoll in 1907, long before barbiturates dominated, and is still sold over the counter in parts of Asia. It belongs to the bromoureides, simple sedatives that release bromide in the body.
fact.zh: 它由 Knoll 公司於 1907 年發現，遠早於巴比妥類盛行的年代，至今在亞洲部分地區仍可在藥局購得。它屬於溴尿素類，是一種會在體內釋出溴離子的簡單鎮靜劑。
fact.zhHans: 它由 Knoll 公司于 1907 年发现，远早于巴比妥类盛行的年代，至今在亚洲部分地区仍可在药局购得。它属于溴尿素类，是一种会在体内发布溴离子的简单镇静剂。
